requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Read the plan as a 30000 mm east–west by 24000 mm north–south site. The 24000 × 12000 mm hall starts at site coordinate (3000,9000), leaving 3000 mm west, east and north setbacks and a 9000 mm south yard. Show public arrival across the south yard to D-01 and item delivery to east-side D-02. Graphic orientation may vary if north and the relationships remain unambiguous; displaced boundaries, incorrect setbacks or swapped arrivals fail.

Compare existing and proposed geometry against the hall-local record, with origin at the southwest exterior corner. Exterior bounds are 24000 × 12000 mm and brick walls are 300 mm thick. C-01–C-05 lie at y=300 and C-06–C-10 at y=11700, using x=300, 6150, 12000, 17850 and 23700 in order; columns are 200 × 200 mm. T-01–T-05 connect corresponding south and north columns at these x coordinates. Retain W-01 south, W-02 east, W-03 north, W-04 west, S-01 slab and R-01 pitched roof. D-01 occupies south x=1500–4500; D-02 east y=1500–4500; D-03 north x=19500–20700. South windows O-01 and O-02 occupy x=7500–9900 and 14100–16500. North-pitch rooflights K-01–K-05 occupy y=7500–9500 and x=1200–4200, 5700–8700, 10200–13200, 14700–17700 and 19200–22200 respectively. Existing P-01 is centred at x=18000 over y=300–11700, 100 mm thick, and must disappear from the proposed built layout. Drawing conventions may vary; omission, relocation, resizing or invented retained openings fail.

Where visible, retain exposed brick, exposed steel columns and trusses, and a patched, sealed concrete floor. New enclosed rooms read as freestanding timber construction with birch plywood below clear upper glazing, leaving the existing roof structure exposed. Interior evidence should agree with plywood rising to 2100 mm, enclosed ceilings at 3000 mm and room tops at 3100 mm. Viewpoint and natural material variation are allowed; covering the retained structure or substituting a different construction system fails.

Provide eight complete records: A-01 Reception 18 m2, A-02 Teaching 54 m2, A-03 Making 60 m2, A-04 Tool Store 18 m2, A-05 Intake 12 m2, A-06 Collection 12 m2, A-07 Accessible Toilet 8 m2 and A-08 Staff Room 10 m2. Every room is Ground Floor. Open zones A-01, A-02, A-03, A-05 and A-06 have 4800 mm clear height; enclosed rooms A-04, A-07 and A-08 have 3000 mm. Record D-01 arrival at Reception, Reception beside Collection with sightline to the Tool Store counter, Teaching beside Making with public-route access, Making connected to Intake and Collection, Intake beside D-02, Tool Store counter facing the public route, Accessible Toilet directly accessible from that route and Staff Room beside Tool Store. Tabular or prose presentation is allowed; missing fields or contradictory assignments fail.

Treat the room specification as the source schedule. The proposed plan repeats all eight name–area pairs, and the sections explicitly dimension 4800 mm from floor to truss underside in open zones and 3000 mm from floor to ceiling underside in enclosed rooms. The transverse cut includes Teaching, a retained truss and a rooflight; the longitudinal cut includes the public route and new rooms. Labels may be repositioned for readability; omissions or disagreement with the source or fixed values fail.

The two sheets supply explicit site and hall dimensions and a four-bay 5850 mm structural dimension chain. Each carries north, a metric scale bar and ±0.000. The comparison preserves C-01–C-10, T-01–T-05, W-01–W-04, S-01, R-01, D-01–D-03, O-01–O-02 and K-01–K-05 with unchanged ID-to-location associations. Label P-01 Removed and additions New. Annotation layout may vary; absent dimensional evidence, missing retained IDs or ambiguous work status fail.

Both drawings show a dimensioned public route at least 1500 mm clear after furniture placement, south-yard arrival through D-01 to Reception and Tool Store, and the ordered item route from D-02 through Intake and Making to Collection. Preserve the specified room adjacencies and Reception's sightline to the lending counter. Place six 1800 × 750 mm tables and twelve 450 × 450 mm chairs in Teaching; four 1800 × 900 mm benches and eight 400 × 400 mm stools in Making; one 2400 × 600 mm counter and three 1200 × 450 mm shelving units in Tool Store; one 1600 × 700 mm desk in Reception; one 1800 × 750 mm worktable in Intake; two 1200 × 450 mm shelves in Collection; and one 900 × 600 mm cart in each of Intake and Collection. Symbols may vary if their footprints and counts are readable; missing inventory, conflicting layouts or obstructed routes fail.

Both sections and the elevation annotate floor ±0.000, truss underside +4.800, eaves +5.400 and ridge +6.900. The transverse structural span is 11400 mm; the longitudinal structure follows five truss centres separated by four 5850 mm bays. South D-01 spans x=1500–4500 with threshold 0 and head 3600; O-01 spans x=7500–9900 and O-02 x=14100–16500, both with sill 1800 and head 3600. Any depicted D-02 has threshold 0 and head 3600; D-03 has threshold 0 and head 2400. Rooflights occupy the recorded north pitch. The junction detail dimensions 18 mm birch plywood and a 20 mm recessed brick connection, coordinated with exposed brick, steel, timber studs and glazed upper room walls in the sections. Drawing conventions may vary; incorrect levels, openings or conflicting assemblies fail.

Both images place the exact project name and phrase at the south public entrance. Typography and sign arrangement may vary while remaining legible and attached to the correct entrance; missing wording, spelling changes or placement at a different frontage fail.

Use Course Day and Open Workshop as the respective view headings. Visibly account for 22 people in Course Day and 16 in Open Workshop, divided into the specified learner, maker and operator counts. Keep six teaching tables, twelve teaching chairs, four making benches and eight making stools in the same arrangement. Course Day has two learners at each table; Open Workshop has one; both have two makers at each bench and operators at Reception and Tool Store. Gestures and camera position may vary; uncountable or incorrect populations, changed inventory or switched headings fail.

All four eye-level views depict the same spatial arrangement and construction as the drawings. The entrance retains D-01 and both south windows; the intake view looks from D-02 into Intake and shows a cart and connection to Making. Visible column bays, openings, rooflight apertures, room heights and material divisions agree with the source drawings. Perspective and occlusion are allowed; invented architectural features, relocated elements or contradictory room relationships fail.

Review the entire video for a ten-second spatial passage beginning at D-01, moving through Reception and reaching Teaching and Making. Compare the visible route, columns, openings, rooflights, material divisions, six teaching tables, four making benches and new-room heights with the drawings. Camera speed and framing may vary; a wrong route or duration, spatial discontinuity, or altered architecture or inventory fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require at least eight pages, with at least one page allocated to each of the eight named topics. The cover prints COMMON REPAIR and Repair together. Repeat all eight room name–area pairs and the 4800 mm open-zone and 3000 mm enclosed-room clear heights from the room specification. State that the entire building closes from 5 October through 13 December 2026 and reopens as one completed workshop on 14 December 2026. Equivalent unambiguous date formatting is allowed; missing topics, incorrect repeated facts or a phased-opening interpretation fail.

Every listed source appears recognizably in the presentation. Scaling, page composition and legible excerpts are allowed if the source's substantive content remains identifiable. A source mentioned only by title, replaced with unrelated imagery or omitted entirely fails.

Drawings share one geometry, retention treatment, circulation layout and construction solution. The proposed plan repeats the source room names and net areas, and sections repeat the source clear heights.

All four views preserve the source drawings' columns, openings, rooflights, room geometry and material divisions. Course Day and Open Workshop use the same equipment arrangement with their specified differing populations.
